output.question: Has Walmart announced layoffs?
output.answer: Yes. The latest Walmart layoffs I found were announced in a May 12, 2026 internal memo to its Global Tech and Product + Design organization. About 1,000 corporate technology and product roles are being cut or relocated as the company consolidates the tech teams that support Walmart U.S., Sam's Club and Walmart International. On June 19, 2026, Walmart filed nine California WARN notices for 394 permanent layoffs: 306 in Sunnyvale and 88 in San Bruno, all with an August 21, 2026 separation date. I found no reports of new Walmart layoff announcements in September–November 2026.

key_facts.fact: Walmart said in a memo that it is eliminating or relocating about 1,000 corporate positions while it streamlines the tech teams supporting Walmart U.S., Sam's Club and Walmart International. The memo came from Suresh Kumar and Daniel Danker.
The internal memo is dated May 12, 2026. Walmart gave no figure in it; the ~1,000 number comes from WSJ reporting. Some people whose roles are eliminated may be offered other jobs within Walmart.
A person familiar with the reorganization said AI automation did not cause the cuts, and Walmart is still hiring at the corporate level, including for tech roles.
On June 19, 2026, Walmart filed nine California WARN notices covering 394 roles (306 in Sunnyvale, 88 in San Bruno). All are permanent layoffs with an August 21, 2026 separation date.
An earlier WARN notice covered 111 employees at a Matteson, Illinois e-commerce facility that is closing.

passages.quote: This has enabled us to create once and scale globally, accelerate innovation and reduce duplication.
other opportunities within Walmart where possible
Walmart cuts 1,000 corporate roles as AI reorganization reshapes tech teams

caveats: Walmart's memo does not give a headcount. The ~1,000 figure comes from WSJ and trade-press reporting, and it counts relocations as well as eliminations.

The California WARN figures (394 roles, June 19 filing, August 21 separation) come from a secondary blog that analyzed California EDD data, not from the EDD report itself. Other outlets cite 306 (Sunnyvale only) or 412. The blog says 412 is wrong because it reuses a May 2025 San Bruno count.
I couldn't open the SF Chronicle and KRON4 articles about the Sunnyvale cuts (paywall/403).
Searches found no new Walmart layoff announcements from September to November 2026, but not finding one doesn't prove there wasn't one.
Walmart also made earlier rounds of cuts, including about 1,500 corporate jobs in May 2025, according to search-result summaries. I did not open those pages to verify them.
missing_fields: Official Walmart corporate press release on the 2026 layoffs (none found)
